About
About Le Café Joséphine

Located at 201 E 20th St in the heart of the Heights, Le Café Joséphine is the kind of neighborhood café that immediately feels inviting the moment you step inside. I often describe it as effortlessly charming, with a relaxed, intimate atmosphere that works equally well for a quiet breakfast, a leisurely brunch, or an unhurried lunch. The space has a calm, welcoming energy that makes it easy to settle in, whether you’re catching up with friends or enjoying a low-key meal on your own. The menu leans toward thoughtfully prepared comfort dishes, and the food consistently stands out for its freshness and balance of flavors. Dishes like the smoked salmon Benedict showcase careful attention to detail, from perfectly cooked eggs to vibrant greens finished with a bright vinaigrette that adds just the right amount of lift. For something more savory and satisfying, options like the falafel baguette deliver hearty textures and juicy, well-seasoned bites that feel both filling and refined. Breakfast offerings such as croissants are flaky and comforting, pairing nicely with simple sides that keep the focus on the main components of the dish. What truly elevates the experience, though, is how everything comes together-the presentation is clean and appealing, the pacing of service feels unhurried yet attentive, and the staff maintain a friendly presence that adds to the café’s approachable vibe. Le Café Joséphine has a way of surprising first-time visitors with how polished yet casual it feels, making it an easy choice for those looking for a pleasant, no-rush dining experience in a peaceful setting, where good food, warm service, and a lovely atmosphere naturally coexist.

Reviews

“ I really enjoy dropping n here for lunch as their house baguettes are some of the best fresh, light and crispy bread around town… and their soup is a nice, original, savory pairing. I’ve also had a couple of great salads here and love some of the Mediterranean underpinnings in the ingredients where it’s also an added upside that the kitchen is halal. A perfect little neighborhood cafe with the right amount of originality and pleasant surprises in a casual setup at fair price points. It’s a plus that they have a compact menu, and take care with what they prepare without wasting time on a giant menu that over reaches. Enjoy. ”

renegadegeeK

“ Casual and quiet spot for breakfast or lunch! The food was good. I ordered a breakfast croissant, the potatoes were a little too bland.. with not much flavor but the croissant balanced it out. ”

Laura V

“ Great Surprise and Lovely Atmosphere Very pleasant experience at Le Café Joséphine! The place has a charming and relaxed vibe, the food was delicious — fresh, well-prepared, and nicely presented — and the service was friendly and attentive. A really good surprise, perfect spot for a relaxed breakfast or brunch. ”

Sergio Morilo Rodrigues

“ Really great atmosphere in the heart of the Heights. Food is delicious and service is excellent. Got a smoked salmon benedict and my fiancée got the falafel baguette. They were both delicious and very juicy. Mine came with a side of greens topped with a vinaigrette sauce which was to die for. Highly recommend this place! ”

Gabriel Martins

“ My partner and I had a wonderful brunch. I ordered the Smoked Salmon Baguette with Avocado which with a little salt and pepper was conquered with only crumbs remaining. Yummy My lady ordered the Breakfast Croissant, and she thoroughly enjoyed it. Also came with a salad that I cleaned up for her. Friendly service, great decor, chill vibes, and outstanding food. ”

Kevin Sinclair

“ Breakfast under chandeliers—now that’s how you start a morning! Le café Joséphine didn’t disappoint: fresh, flavorful plates, friendly vibe, and twinkle-lit charm that makes every bite feel special. A cozy gem I’ll be coming back to again and again. ”

Joel Lutringer

“ My husband and I just returned from France and were in need of a baguette. Stopped by Le café joséphine to satisfy our craving. Delicious breakfast, lattes, and pastries. I took a large sized cookie to go. Quiet space with two outlets if you need to work remotely. I am down the street daily while I wait for my child to get out of school, and can’t believe I have never been until today. Hardly see anyone when I drive by throughout the day so I hope this cafe stays open. 201 E 20th St, Houston, TX 77008 Open daily 8am - 4pm ”

Priscilla Martinez
